title: Research Design and Methods in Public Administration
description: Examines research approaches and methodologies employed in public administration, concentrating on designing research projects: objectives of research, literature review, conceptual framing, research design, collecting and analysing data and presenting findings. Students critically appraise key methodological and methods issues, identify a topic and develop a dissertation proposal.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ADMN 602, ADMN 502A, ADMN 557.
